jobs.title: Vice President, Software Development
jobs.description:
Job Description

Cytel is a global leader in statistical software and advanced analytics for clinical research and drug development. For nearly four decades, Cytel has pioneered innovative statistical methodologies and software solutions that help pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies make better decisions, accelerate clinical development, and bring life-changing therapies to patients.

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Vice President of Software Development
to lead our global software development organization. This executive will be responsible for the strategy, execution, and operational excellence of Cytel's software engineering function, encompassing software development, statistical methodology development, quality assurance, DevOps, and technical project management.

The VP of Software Development will play a critical role in translating Cytel's product vision and scientific innovation into scalable, reliable, secure, and commercially successful software solutions. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise, exceptional organizational leadership, and a disciplined approach to software delivery with an understanding of the unique requirements of scientific software development within the pharmaceutical industry.

This position requires a leader capable of managing multidisciplinary teams, modernizing development practices, scaling engineering capabilities, and fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Software Engineering Leadership & Strategy
Provide executive leadership and strategic direction for Cytel's global software development organization, including software engineers, statistical methodologists, quality assurance professionals, DevOps engineers, and project managers.
Develop and execute a comprehensive software engineering strategy aligned with Cytel's product roadmap, commercial objectives, and long-term technology vision.
Establish and maintain a high-performing engineering organization capable of delivering multiple software products and initiatives simultaneously.
Define engineering standards, architectural principles, development methodologies, and technology strategies that promote scalability, maintainability, security, and performance.
Evaluate emerging technologies, development frameworks, and engineering practices, including artificial intelligence and AI-assisted software development, to improve innovation and productivity.
Balance investments in new product capabilities, technical debt reduction, architectural modernization, and ongoing product maintenance.
Partner closely with Product Management to translate product strategy and customer requirements into actionable engineering plans.
Software Development & Product Delivery
Assume executive accountability for the successful delivery of Cytel's software product roadmap, ensuring commitments are met with predictable timelines, appropriate resource utilization, and high-quality outcomes.
Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through testing, release, deployment, and maintenance.
Establish effective Agile and other fit-for-purpose development practices that support both iterative product development and complex scientific software engineering.
Drive continuous improvements in engineering productivity, development velocity, release frequency, and delivery predictability.
Ensure effective prioritization and resource allocation across multiple products, projects, and development teams.
Establish transparent reporting mechanisms and key performance indicators to monitor project execution, delivery risks, engineering capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
Proactively identify and resolve technical, organizational, and operational obstacles that threaten product delivery.
Scientific Methodology Development & Computational Excellence
Lead and support teams of statistical methodologists responsible for the research, design, implementation, and validation of advanced statistical and computational methods incorporated into Cytel's software products.
Foster close collaboration between statistical scientists, software engineers, and product managers to ensure scientific innovation is translated into robust, commercially viable software capabilities.
Establish rigorous processes for scientific verification, numerical accuracy, reproducibility, and computational performance.
Ensure that statistical algorithms and scientific software implementations meet the high standards of accuracy, reliability, and transparency expected by pharmaceutical customers and regulatory stakeholders.
Promote effective collaboration with internal and external scientific experts, academic researchers, and industry partners.
Support the integration of emerging statistical methods, simulation techniques, machine learning, and other advanced analytical approaches into Cytel's software portfolio.
Quality Assurance, Validation & Regulatory Readiness
Provide executive oversight of software quality assurance, testing, and validation practices across the product portfolio.
Establish and continuously improve comprehensive quality management processes encompassing automated testing, regression testing, performance testing, security testing, and scientific algorithm validation.
Ensure software development and quality processes support applicable regulatory expectations and customer requirements, including GxP-related considerations, where appropriate.
Promote strong traceability, documentation, reproducibility, and change-control practices consistent with the requirements of pharmaceutical and biotechnology customers.
Drive a culture in which quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle rather than treated as a downstream activity.
Establish measurable quality objectives and continuously reduce defect rates, production incidents, and customer-reported software issues.
DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering Operations
Lead DevOps and engineering infrastructure functions responsible for build systems, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), release engineering, deployment automation, and development environments.
Drive the adoption of modern DevSecOps practices, incorporating security, reliability, and compliance into automated engineering workflows.
Oversee the technical infrastructure supporting cloud-based SaaS products, including availability, scalability, observability, performance, and operational resilience.
Establish effective processes for incident management, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity in collaboration with IT and security leadership.
Optimize cloud infrastructure utilization and engineering operating costs while maintaining appropriate service levels.
Ensure development and deployment processes support Cytel's evolving portfolio of desktop, cloud-based, and enterprise software solutions.
Project Management & Operational Excellence
Oversee the technical project management function, ensuring disciplined planning, execution, risk management, and cross-functional coordination.
Establish consistent governance processes for engineering initiatives, including milestone tracking, resource planning, dependency management, and executive reporting.
Develop engineering capacity plans and budgets aligned with product priorities and commercial commitments.
Improve the predictability of software delivery through effective estimation, performance measurement, and continuous process improvement.
Manage relationships with external development partners, technology vendors, and contractors, as appropriate.
Establish a performance-driven operating model that balances delivery speed, scientific rigor, product quality, and financial discipline.
Talent Development & Organizational Leadership
Build, develop, and retain a world-class, multidisciplinary software development organization.
Lead organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent acquisition across engineering, methodology, QA, DevOps, and project management functions.
Recruit, mentor, and develop strong technical leaders capable of scaling teams and driving organizational performance.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, accountability structures, and performance expectations.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and results-oriented culture characterized by technical excellence, scientific curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.
Promote knowledge sharing, technical mentorship, and professional development across teams.
Establish effective strategies for leveraging geographically distributed development teams.
Executive Collaboration & Business Partnership
Serve as a key member of Cytel's software leadership team, contributing to product strategy, technology investment decisions, organizational planning, and business performance.
Partner closely with the Chief Product Officer and Product Management leadership to ensure alignment between product strategy, engineering capabilities, investment priorities, and delivery commitments.
Collaborate with commercial, customer success, professional services, and support teams to address customer requirements and ensure product quality and customer satisfaction.
Participate in strategic customer discussions, particularly those involving technical architecture, product capabilities, software quality, security, and deployment requirements.
Communicate engineering strategy, organizational performance, risks, and investment requirements clearly to executive stakeholders.
Contribute to build-versus-buy decisions, technology partnerships, and the technical evaluation of potential acquisitions or integrations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline.
15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, including substantial experience leading large, multidisciplinary software development organizations.
7+ years of senior engineering leadership experience, preferably at the Director, Senior Director, or Vice President level.
Demonstrated success delivering complex commercial software products within a multi-product software organization.
Proven experience leading teams encompassing software engineering, QA, DevOps, and technical project management.
Strong understanding of modern software architectures, cloud computing, SaaS platforms, APIs, databases, and software development frameworks.
Extensive experience with Agile software development, CI/CD, automated testing, DevSecOps, and modern engineering management practices.
Demonstrated ability to establish engineering performance metrics, improve delivery predictability, and drive organizational transformation.
Experience managing engineering budgets, resource allocation, organizational growth, and geographically distributed teams.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing scientific, statistical, analytical, or other computationally intensive commercial software products.
Familiarity with pharmaceutical clinical development, biostatistics, clinical trial design, or regulatory science.
Experience managing teams of statistical scientists, quantitative researchers, or scientific methodologists alongside software engineering teams.
Understanding of statistical programming environments and technologies such as R, Python, C++, and related computational frameworks.
Experience with software quality and validation requirements in regulated industries, including pharmaceutical GxP environments.
Experience developing products deployed in both traditional desktop and modern cloud/SaaS architectures.
Familiarity with numerical computing, simulation, high-performance computing, and scientific algorithm validation.

jobs.title: Director, Data Management
jobs.description:
The Director, Data Management will have overall responsibility for the Data Management team, including Clinical Data Managers, Clinical Data Coordinators, Clinical Study Builders and Clinical Data Coders.

The Director, Data Management, will provide strategic leadership and oversight of data management resources, processes, and deliverables, ensuring the quality, integrity, and timely delivery of clinical trial data.

The Director, Data Management will oversee and participate in all clinical data management activities required to ensure that data captured in clinical trials undertaken, or managed by Indero, are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines and Indero’s SOP while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines.

More specifically, the Director, Data Management must:

Strategic Leadership and Collaboration

Inspire, lead and develop all functions within Data Management by helping to formulate a clear vision for the future and attracting and retaining top talent.
Define and drive the Data Management strategy and roadmap, including innovation, standardization and automation initiatives that support the company’s business objectives.
Collaborate with Biostatistics, Risk-Based Study Management, Project Management and other function leaders to align strategies, processes and tools, and to ensure integrated delivery of clinical trial data.
Represent Data Management in sponsor and client meetings and manage the escalation of study risks and issues related to Data Management deliverables.
Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes in clinical data management.
Provide leadership and accountability to study teams assigned to the dedicated client portfolio.

People and Resource Management

Provide direct oversight of data management operations, including planning and assigning work, overseeing the performance of direct reports and conducting performance reviews.
Evaluate the performance of assigned project personnel.
Oversee and provide ongoing training/mentoring to data management and programming staff and review/approve documentation generated by staff, as necessary.
Ensure that all trainings assigned to oneself and to direct and indirect reports are completed on time, and provide direct and indirect reports with appropriate support.
Oversee resource allocation for Data Management activities across clinical trials and internal initiatives.
Lead the development of flexible resourcing strategies, including internal and external resources, to meet the evolving demands of the company.
Adhere to and promote company values and related expected behaviors and follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables.

Financial Management and Oversight

Oversee budget and resources allocated for Data Management.
Lead the annual Data Management budget planning.
Be responsible for the operational and financial health of Data Management-supported clinical trials by monitoring key operational metrics and supporting budget oversight and forecasting.
Participate in the review of Master Service Agreements (MSA) and work orders with external service providers, process and track payment requests to ensure accordance with the budget and the needs of the study.
Develop Work Orders with external service providers, process and track payment requests to ensure accordance with the budget and the needs of the study.
Oversee activities performed by external service providers to ensure they are done in accordance with effective Work Orders, applicable regulations and Indero SOPs (if applicable).
Oversee the selection, implementation and ongoing management of Data Management systems (e.g., EDC) and strategic technology vendors.

Operational Excellence, Quality and Compliance

Oversee development and optimization of Data Management processes with specific focus on efficiency and quality, while maintaining or exceeding industry best practices.
Define, analyze and monitor Data Management key performance indicators (KPIs) and quality metrics to ensure quality, compliance and timely delivery, and report on performance to senior leadership.
Ensure that Data Management standards, SOPs, processes and trainings are aligned with applicable ICH-GCP guidelines, regulatory authority requirements and industry best practices.
Oversee the definition, writing and updating of data management SOPs.
Monitor timelines and ensure that data management deadlines are met.

Clinical Data Management Delivery

Provide escalation support and expertise to project teams, sponsors and external vendors on complex data management matters, as needed.
Provide support and close oversight to data management team activities for clinical trials from the development of study protocols to the completion of study reports.
Oversee the development of eCRF specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
Oversee the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
Oversee the validation and testing of the clinical database e.g. User Acceptance Testing.
Oversee the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
Oversee the development of data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).
Oversee the review/development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
Oversee ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct.
Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the eTMF.
Oversee the archiving of the clinical database and related documents.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements:

B.Sc. or M.Sc., or related field;
Minimum of 8 years of leadership experience, plus at least 15 years of clinical trials experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical or CRO industry.
Proven experience leading and developing data management teams and managing multiple studies and sponsor portfolios.
Demonstrated experience leading global or cross-functional initiatives and influencing strategy across multiple stakeholders.
Experience with budget planning and resource management, including the oversight of external vendors.
Experience in the setup, validation and oversight of EDC systems and other clinical data systems.
Experience supporting sponsor audits and regulatory inspections is an asset.
Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM), and applicable data protection regulations.
Strategic thinking, with the ability to define a vision and translate it into operational plans.
Strong leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to teach, train and mentor employees at all levels.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization and with external stakeholders in a matrix, cross-functional environment.
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Sound judgment, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; French is an asset.
Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company:

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

Permanent full-time position
Flexible schedule
Vacation
Home-based position
Ongoing learning and development

﻿About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology!

﻿Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

﻿Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. We are looking for a Director of Technical Program Management to lead a senior team of TPMs driving Instacart's most critical Engineering Foundations initiatives across Data Infrastructure, Developer Infrastructure, Platform, AI enablement, Privacy, and Reliability. You will partner closely with VPs and Directors of Engineering, Finance, Legal, GRC, Data Science, and other cross-functional leaders. This is a terrific opportunity for a technical leader who is passionate about people, program management, and engineering, and who understands that our success hinges on our ability to deliver impact as a team.

The Technical Program Management team leads Instacart's most impactful cross-functional efforts, bringing technical expertise, product sense, and business acumen to deliver highly complex initiatives at scale.

About The Job

Lead and grow a senior team of TPMs, building a vision for a high-performing TPM organization while actively mentoring and developing individuals to succeed.
Shape the vision, strategy, and investment needs across Engineering Foundations, including data product strategy, data quality and governance, financial data transformation, AI enablement, privacy, and reliability.
Drive a step change in how Engineering Foundations operates: clear reliability expectations, real-time visibility into top-line metrics, and proactive investment decisions owned by each pillar.
Partner with VPs, Senior Directors, and Directors of Engineering and with leaders in Finance, Legal, and Security to enable effective strategic planning and timely execution of company-critical programs.
Present regularly to the CTO and influence engineering leadership on key investments needed to hold a high bar on our operational health.
Use your technical knowledge and product sense to drive data-driven decisions, negotiate prioritization, weigh long-term and short-term investments, and reduce ambiguity and risk.
Enable the company to expand into new markets with privacy and regulatory compliance in strong shape.
Build a team culture of curiosity, impact, and ownership that reinforces the core values of Instacart.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product management in a technical domain, or a related discipline.
Track record as both a strong individual contributor and a people leader, with experience leading and growing a team of TPMs or engineers.
Experience in infrastructure domains (such as data infrastructure, developer infrastructure, platform, reliability, or privacy) at scale.
Demonstrated influence on technical or business strategy, with a record of measurable outcomes delivered for the organization.
Proven ability to influence senior engineering and executive leaders, resolve conflict, and build consensus while navigating ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in infrastructure at a leading technology company operating at scale, as both an individual contributor and a leader.
Experience with data governance, privacy, or regulatory compliance programs.
Experience supporting executive-level operating reviews and engineering planning processes.

Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Technology is one of the most important parts of Warner Music Group’s business. Whether it is supporting artists and songwriters, delivering accurate royalty and performance data to global partners, or giving creative and business teams modern data and AI tools, engineering makes it possible.

Strong technical judgment across system design, cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP), APIs, data platforms, and modern delivery practices.
Proven ability to hire, coach, and grow managers and engineers, and to handle performance issues with care and clarity.
Excellent communication and influencing skills with executives, product partners, and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience with data and ML platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks) and applying AI/agentic tooling in engineering workflows.
Experience leading globally distributed teams.

The Winnipeg Civic Employees’ Benefits Program (WCEBP) is a public-sector, jointly trusteed organization that provides pension and long-term disability benefits to employees of the City of Winnipeg and eight other participating employers. With origins dating to 1921, today WCEBP serves more than 19,500 members and manages approximately $8.7 billion in assets, making its pension plan one of the largest in Manitoba, in addition, WCBBP is a third-party administrator of the Winnipeg Police Pension Plan with 3,000 members and AUM of $2.8 billion. The plan is entering an exciting modernization period, providing an opportunity to make an impact at scale in a highly regarded, stable and well managed financial leader.

Reporting to the CEO, the Chief Financial Officer provides strategic leadership, oversight, and stewardship of the WCEBP’s financial management, enterprise risk management, regulatory compliance oversight, internal controls, human resources, and facilities functions. The CFO serves as a strategic advisor to the Chief Executive Officer, Boards of Trustees, Audit Committees, Governance Committee, and senior leadership, providing advice and operational support aligned with WCEBP’s strategic priorities and fiduciary responsibilities. The CFO will play a key role advancing enterprise risk management, stewarding an exciting transformation, and inspiring a young, capable team.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned finance executive with industry experience related to pensions such as financial services (benefits, insurance, etc.), public sector, or similar complex, regulated, unionized or fiduciary environment. Actuarial valuation experience is strongly preferred. Preferably, they will have managed departments beyond finance, such as HR, risk, facilities or corporate services. Armed with a CPA and extensive financial reporting experience, they will bring governance experience supporting Boards as well as change management experience leading a modernization program. Expertise in enterprise risk, internal controls, compliance is preferred; sound professional judgment, strong communication skills and the ability to build trust across diverse stakeholder groups is required.

Based in Winnipeg, this is a compelling opportunity to join a mission-driven organization whose work directly supports the financial security and well-being of civic employees, retirees and their beneficiaries. The incoming CFO will have the opportunity to shape WCEBP’s evolving financial, risk and corporate infrastructure, lead an integrated team and provide independent, strategic advice within a sophisticated multi-stakeholder governance environment. For an accomplished executive seeking meaningful work with enduring public purpose, the role offers broad organizational influence and the ability to strengthen the sustainability, resilience and stewardship of benefits relied upon by thousands of Manitobans.

jobs.title: Vice President, General Ledger Accounting
jobs.description:
Description

Job Overview:

The Vice President, General Ledger Accounting
will lead the General Ledger Accounting function for an assigned portfolio of markets and regions. The Vice President is accountable for the overall performance of the GL teams that prepare, review and deliver monthly financial statements and related client deliverables for the communities supported within that portfolio.

Reporting to the SVP, Client Accounting, the Vice President will establish the strategic direction, operating priorities and performance expectations for the assigned GL organization. The role will work closely with market and regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and Client Accounting Shared Services partners to ensure financial statements are accurate, timely and supported by consistent processes, strong controls, effective issue escalation and disciplined performance management.

The Vice President will lead transformation and standardization across the assigned portfolio while ensuring the operating model remains responsive to local market needs, management agreements, governing documents and client expectations. The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically strong and service-oriented leader who can develop leaders, create accountability, resolve complex reporting issues and improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of financial statement delivery.

Due to the global nature of this position, the Vice President should be comfortable working across multiple time zones (Pacific Standard Time to Eastern Standard Time), within reason.

Job Responsibilities

The job duties listed are typical examples of the work performed by positions in this job classification. Not all duties assigned to every position are included, nor is it expected that all positions will be assigned every duty.

General Ledger Accounting

Provide executive ownership of the monthly close and financial statement reporting cycle for all communities within the assigned portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely delivery in accordance with internal policies and procedures, regulatory requirements, management agreements, property governing documents and client expectations.
Establish the portfolio’s operating rhythm, reporting timetables, quality standards, review protocols, escalation paths and delivery-tracking requirements for monthly financial statements.
Ensure the integrity of general ledger activity, including account reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses and amortization, fixed assets, interfund and reserve activity, cost recovery billings and other client deliverables.
Serve as the senior escalation authority for complex accounting matters, financial statement exceptions, late or at-risk deliverables and significant client or operational issues within the assigned portfolio.
Oversee GL support for annual client audits and budgets, special assessments, loans, mortgages and other significant client financial obligations.
Establish and monitor service level and key performance indicators for financial statement delivery
Drive leadership accountability for results against service-level and key performance indicators, reviewing performance regularly and leading corrective action plans where targets are missed.
Build the leadership capability, succession plans, organizational structure and workforce capacity required to support client growth, retention and changing business needs.
Attract, develop and retain high-caliber leaders and accounting professionals while promoting a culture of collaboration, accountability, trust and service excellence.

Business Partner

Serve as the senior Client Accounting business partner for market presidents, regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and other senior stakeholders within the assigned portfolio.
Partner with the VP, Accounts Receivable and Resales; VP, Accounts Payable; Senior Director, Treasury Services; and other Client Accounting leaders to ensure cohesive end-to-end service delivery and timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
Translate portfolio performance, operational trends and accounting risks into clear recommendations and decisions for the SVP, Client Accounting and senior market leadership.
Build strong relationships with supported markets to understand local culture, client requirements and operating needs while reinforcing enterprise standards and shared-services objectives.
Act as a senior resource for board members, property and association managers and other stakeholders by leading the resolution of significant accounting and financial reporting matters.
Represent General Ledger Accounting in senior leadership forums, cross-functional initiatives and major business decisions affecting client accounting and reporting.

Financial Planning

Develop and manage the GL operating budget for the assigned portfolio, including headcount planning, forecasts, productivity assumptions and variance analysis.
Align staffing, leadership capacity and workload to the monthly close cycle, client growth, market transitions and service requirements.
Develop business cases and investment recommendations for organizational changes, systems, automation, training and process improvement initiatives.
Monitor portfolio capacity and cost-to-serve indicators and take action when workload or service demand exceeds available resources.

People Management

Lead a team of 125+ associates through a senior leadership structure within North America
Attract, develop and retain diverse, high-caliber talent, while developing an engaged team to build the capabilities required for the organization to perform at high levels.
Promote a culture of collaboration, trust and support.
Clearly define and communicate performance responsibilities, goals, expectations and objectives.
Regularly evaluate teams to determine performance and whether company standards for work performance are met. If expectations are not met, are responsible for coaching and corrective actions.
Conduct ongoing performance management activities by providing constructive feedback and coaching through regular check-ins, structured one-on-one meetings, mid-year touchpoints and annual reviews.

Project Management

Provide executive sponsorship and governance for large-scale GL initiatives affecting the assigned portfolio, including market integrations, client transitions and accounting platform migrations.
Establish project objectives, decision rights, accountability, milestones, risks and escalation paths in partnership with project and functional leaders.
Ensure market and GL team readiness through effective planning, communication, training, change management and post-implementation support.
Provide clear status updates to senior leadership on timeline, accomplishments, decisions, risks, issues and required support.

Business Process Improvement

Lead the standardization and continuous improvement of GL processes, review practices, controls and workflows across the assigned markets and regions.
Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, service-level expectations, process documentation and governance for the GL function.
Partner with the Business Transformation and technology teams to define business requirements, prioritize enhancements, improve reporting capabilities and support adoption of enterprise accounting platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to automate, centralize or redesign work while maintaining accountability, control integrity and service quality.
Develop dashboards that provide visibility into financial statement delivery, quality, productivity, backlog, capacity, risk and technology adoption.
Use performance data, root-cause analysis and market feedback to identify systemic issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Share and implement leading practices across the GL organization and collaborate with peer functional leaders to improve end-to-end Client Accounting processes.

Compliance & Governance

Maintain an effective internal control environment over the general ledger and financial reporting functions, including segregation of duties, review controls, documentation standards and escalation procedures.
Ensure GL processes adhere to applicable accounting standards, federal and state requirements, company policies, standard operating procedures, management agreements and client-specific obligations.
Coordinate with internal and external auditors on audit requests, control reviews, year-end support and remediation activities.
Monitor regulatory, accounting and industry developments that may affect client accounting operations and lead implementation of required changes across the assigned portfolio.
Ensure the appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information and safeguard client and company assets.

Additional Duties

Partner with the SVP, Client Accounting and other GL leaders to carry out the strategy, operating model and priorities for General Ledger Accounting.
Practice and adhere to FirstService Residential Global Service Standards.
Always conduct business with the highest standards of personal, professional and ethical conduct.
Anticipate needs across supported markets and manage department resources to provide timely and reliable service; prioritize and communicate when requests exceed capacity.
Complete special projects and perform other duties as assigned related to the stated objective for the position.

Skills & Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Strong analytical skills to perform data collection and benchmarking against best practices.
Manage in a no surprises manner; proactively communicate financial issues to leaders.
Ability to communicate a clear strategy and vision for General Ledger Accounting across our organization and have experience in leading change management initiatives that bring people, process, and technology together from different functional areas to deliver a quality financial services customer experience necessary.
Passion for gaining efficiency through process change while creating a positive team environment where we can recruit, develop, and retain talent.
Comfort with rolling out new technologies, automation and outsourcing to third parties to improve accuracy, timeliness and maximize efficiencies a must.
Knowledge leader in both financial accounting and the Condo/HOA industry. Sound business acumen and the ability to present practical solutions is a key requirement.
Experience interacting with or working through change management items with field operations personnel.
Exposure to a company/industry in rapid transformation (people, process, technology, customer experience).
Familiarity with projects focused on the implementation of new enterprise-wide technology platforms.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high level of independence and accountability for their work.
Familiarity or practical experience with Agile program management methodology necessary.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree plus an accounting designation is essential together with prior experience in a senior financial operations role.

Physical Requirements & Working Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Sitting at a desk for extended periods of time
Dexterity for keyboard and mouse use
Ability to lift up to 30 lbs.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Hours over and above normal office hours will occur, including evenings, holidays, and some weekends. Schedule is subject to change based on business needs.

Description

Job Overview:

The Vice President, General Ledger Accounting
will lead the General Ledger Accounting function for an assigned portfolio of markets and regions. The Vice President is accountable for the overall performance of the GL teams that prepare, review and deliver monthly financial statements and related client deliverables for the communities supported within that portfolio.

Reporting to the SVP, Client Accounting, the Vice President will establish the strategic direction, operating priorities and performance expectations for the assigned GL organization. The role will work closely with market and regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and Client Accounting Shared Services partners to ensure financial statements are accurate, timely and supported by consistent processes, strong controls, effective issue escalation and disciplined performance management.

The Vice President will lead transformation and standardization across the assigned portfolio while ensuring the operating model remains responsive to local market needs, management agreements, governing documents and client expectations. The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically strong and service-oriented leader who can develop leaders, create accountability, resolve complex reporting issues and improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of financial statement delivery.

Due to the global nature of this position, the Vice President should be comfortable working across multiple time zones (Pacific Standard Time to Eastern Standard Time), within reason.

Job Responsibilities

The job duties listed are typical examples of the work performed by positions in this job classification. Not all duties assigned to every position are included, nor is it expected that all positions will be assigned every duty.

General Ledger Accounting

Provide executive ownership of the monthly close and financial statement reporting cycle for all communities within the assigned portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely delivery in accordance with internal policies and procedures, regulatory requirements, management agreements, property governing documents and client expectations.
Establish the portfolio’s operating rhythm, reporting timetables, quality standards, review protocols, escalation paths and delivery-tracking requirements for monthly financial statements.
Ensure the integrity of general ledger activity, including account reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses and amortization, fixed assets, interfund and reserve activity, cost recovery billings and other client deliverables.
Serve as the senior escalation authority for complex accounting matters, financial statement exceptions, late or at-risk deliverables and significant client or operational issues within the assigned portfolio.
Oversee GL support for annual client audits and budgets, special assessments, loans, mortgages and other significant client financial obligations.
Establish and monitor service level and key performance indicators for financial statement delivery
Drive leadership accountability for results against service-level and key performance indicators, reviewing performance regularly and leading corrective action plans where targets are missed.
Build the leadership capability, succession plans, organizational structure and workforce capacity required to support client growth, retention and changing business needs.
Attract, develop and retain high-caliber leaders and accounting professionals while promoting a culture of collaboration, accountability, trust and service excellence.

Business Partner

Serve as the senior Client Accounting business partner for market presidents, regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and other senior stakeholders within the assigned portfolio.
Partner with the VP, Accounts Receivable and Resales; VP, Accounts Payable; Senior Director, Treasury Services; and other Client Accounting leaders to ensure cohesive end-to-end service delivery and timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
Translate portfolio performance, operational trends and accounting risks into clear recommendations and decisions for the SVP, Client Accounting and senior market leadership.
Build strong relationships with supported markets to understand local culture, client requirements and operating needs while reinforcing enterprise standards and shared-services objectives.
Act as a senior resource for board members, property and association managers and other stakeholders by leading the resolution of significant accounting and financial reporting matters.
Represent General Ledger Accounting in senior leadership forums, cross-functional initiatives and major business decisions affecting client accounting and reporting.

Financial Planning

Develop and manage the GL operating budget for the assigned portfolio, including headcount planning, forecasts, productivity assumptions and variance analysis.
Align staffing, leadership capacity and workload to the monthly close cycle, client growth, market transitions and service requirements.
Develop business cases and investment recommendations for organizational changes, systems, automation, training and process improvement initiatives.
Monitor portfolio capacity and cost-to-serve indicators and take action when workload or service demand exceeds available resources.

People Management

Lead a team of 125+ associates through a senior leadership structure within North America
Attract, develop and retain diverse, high-caliber talent, while developing an engaged team to build the capabilities required for the organization to perform at high levels.
Promote a culture of collaboration, trust and support.
Clearly define and communicate performance responsibilities, goals, expectations and objectives.
Regularly evaluate teams to determine performance and whether company standards for work performance are met. If expectations are not met, are responsible for coaching and corrective actions.
Conduct ongoing performance management activities by providing constructive feedback and coaching through regular check-ins, structured one-on-one meetings, mid-year touchpoints and annual reviews.

Project Management

Provide executive sponsorship and governance for large-scale GL initiatives affecting the assigned portfolio, including market integrations, client transitions and accounting platform migrations.
Establish project objectives, decision rights, accountability, milestones, risks and escalation paths in partnership with project and functional leaders.
Ensure market and GL team readiness through effective planning, communication, training, change management and post-implementation support.
Provide clear status updates to senior leadership on timeline, accomplishments, decisions, risks, issues and required support.

Business Process Improvement

Lead the standardization and continuous improvement of GL processes, review practices, controls and workflows across the assigned markets and regions.
Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, service-level expectations, process documentation and governance for the GL function.
Partner with the Business Transformation and technology teams to define business requirements, prioritize enhancements, improve reporting capabilities and support adoption of enterprise accounting platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to automate, centralize or redesign work while maintaining accountability, control integrity and service quality.
Develop dashboards that provide visibility into financial statement delivery, quality, productivity, backlog, capacity, risk and technology adoption.
Use performance data, root-cause analysis and market feedback to identify systemic issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Share and implement leading practices across the GL organization and collaborate with peer functional leaders to improve end-to-end Client Accounting processes.

Compliance & Governance

Maintain an effective internal control environment over the general ledger and financial reporting functions, including segregation of duties, review controls, documentation standards and escalation procedures.
Ensure GL processes adhere to applicable accounting standards, federal and state requirements, company policies, standard operating procedures, management agreements and client-specific obligations.
Coordinate with internal and external auditors on audit requests, control reviews, year-end support and remediation activities.
Monitor regulatory, accounting and industry developments that may affect client accounting operations and lead implementation of required changes across the assigned portfolio.
Ensure the appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information and safeguard client and company assets.

Additional Duties

Partner with the SVP, Client Accounting and other GL leaders to carry out the strategy, operating model and priorities for General Ledger Accounting.
Practice and adhere to FirstService Residential Global Service Standards.
Always conduct business with the highest standards of personal, professional and ethical conduct.
Anticipate needs across supported markets and manage department resources to provide timely and reliable service; prioritize and communicate when requests exceed capacity.
Complete special projects and perform other duties as assigned related to the stated objective for the position.

Skills & Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Strong analytical skills to perform data collection and benchmarking against best practices.
Manage in a no surprises manner; proactively communicate financial issues to leaders.
Ability to communicate a clear strategy and vision for General Ledger Accounting across our organization and have experience in leading change management initiatives that bring people, process, and technology together from different functional areas to deliver a quality financial services customer experience necessary.
Passion for gaining efficiency through process change while creating a positive team environment where we can recruit, develop, and retain talent.
Comfort with rolling out new technologies, automation and outsourcing to third parties to improve accuracy, timeliness and maximize efficiencies a must.
Knowledge leader in both financial accounting and the Condo/HOA industry. Sound business acumen and the ability to present practical solutions is a key requirement.
Experience interacting with or working through change management items with field operations personnel.
Exposure to a company/industry in rapid transformation (people, process, technology, customer experience).
Familiarity with projects focused on the implementation of new enterprise-wide technology platforms.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high level of independence and accountability for their work.
Familiarity or practical experience with Agile program management methodology necessary.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree plus an accounting designation is essential together with prior experience in a senior financial operations role.

Physical Requirements & Working Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Sitting at a desk for extended periods of time
Dexterity for keyboard and mouse use
Ability to lift up to 30 lbs.

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

Travel to Office expectations**

For Remote Roles
: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles
: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

Team Summary

Strategy & Corporate Development is a small team that partners directly with PointClickCare’s Executive Team to decide where the company plays and how it wins over the next 3 – 5 years. This team owns the full arc from insight generation to stakeholder alignment—shaping long-range strategy and financial planning; tracking market, competitive, and regulatory shifts across long-term and post-acute care; sizing our highest-impact new growth opportunities; and deciding whether to build, buy, or partner to capture these opportunities. When the answer is buy, the same team sources, evaluates, negotiates, and closes relevant transactions (M&A, joint ventures), setting them up for successful integration and performance against underwriting theses. This is a small, but high-impact team with consistent opportunities for driving impactful decisions and meaningful senior leadership-level exposure.

The team operates in a hybrid model, with most roles based in Toronto and a few remote across the US, consisting of one SVP, two Directors, one Senior Manager, one Manager, and one Senior Analyst.

Job Summary

As PointClickCare approaches $1 billion in ARR, ensuring the whole company aligns behind a clear, coherent strategy becomes ever more critical.

The Strategy & Corporate Development Director leads enterprise-level strategy initiatives that shape PointClickCare’s long-term growth agenda, portfolio priorities, and investment decisions. The Director independently frames complex and ambiguous strategic questions, integrates perspectives across end-markets and functions, and develops recommendations for the Executive Team and Board. As a strategic thought partner to the SVP, Strategy & Corporate Development, the Director leads major components of long-range and annual planning, drives alignment on enterprise priorities, and provides direction and quality oversight to other team members supporting strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the identification, stack-ranking prioritization, and provide recommendations to the organization around our highest-potential growth opportunities that support the company’s aspirations through whitespace analyses, market inventory and pricing outlooks, and assessment of how customers’ business models are evolving
Lead strategic assessments of market, customer, competitive, and regulatory developments. Synthesize and frame major, future-weighted headwinds and tailwinds into clear hypotheses, supported by proprietary intelligence, advising the Executive Team on the “What? So What? Now What?”
Lead major components of PointClickCare’s enterprise strategic planning process, translating long-term strategic priorities into financial assumptions, enterprise objectives, investment requirements, and measurable performance indicators. Integrate inputs across end-markets and functions, challenge inconsistent assumptions, and escalate material risks, gaps, and trade-offs for Executive Team decision.
Formulate, refine, and cascade our play-to-win strategy across all end-markets to the organization, ensuring senior leadership buy-in on where the company will play, how it will win, and what it will deprioritize, and establish mechanisms to monitor execution against agreed strategic priorities.
Contribute to and inform portfolio management and capital allocation decisions, including building the case for major organic and inorganic investments, evaluating M&A and joint ventures, and assessing divestitures and wind-downs. Develop and present investment recommendations, articulate financial and strategic trade-offs, challenge underlying assumptions, and advise senior leadership on whether and how PointClickCare should proceed.
Coach and mentor junior team members, providing guidance and feedback that strengthens strategic thinking, analytical rigor, executive communication, and independent judgment.

Required Skills & Experience

7+ years of experience at a top management consulting firm, private equity, investment bank, or in-house strategy experience at a scaled, sponsor-backed business
Successful track record leading or contributing to evaluation of expansion in existing and new segments, including market entry options for new businesses, go-to-market strategy for new product offerings, and build-buy-partner assessments
Demonstrated qualitative (market research, synthesis, hypothesis development) and quantitative (Excel, financial modeling) analytical skills
Strong financial acumen and ability to understand core business levers
Exceptional communicator, able to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner both verbally and in writing
Self-starter who thrives and can manage multiple workstreams in fast-paced environments

Preferred Experience

Familiarity with the US healthcare system
Exposure to SaaS and HCIT business models and metrics
Experience working directly with Executive Teams, Boards, and investors
